status_detail: Project website says the company is in intensive pre-development phases for an AI data center in Dawson County near Glendive, with SPP/Basin Electric access, leased ranch land, options to buy up to three 360-acre sites, 200-250 peak construction workers, and up to 60 permanent jobs. Public-search results also indicate no county application was on the table as of mid-2026, so treat as early-stage/pre-application.
notes: Project-company website is the primary source; no capacity figure found on the project page. A ZoomInfo profile mentions a combined energy package of 400 MW wind, 375 MW gas, 200 MW solar, and 50 MW battery for advanced AI operations, but that is not used as data center IT load.

status_detail: No county-specific data center project or application found.
notes: ADLC official search and meeting-material results show public discussion/rumors and regional impacts from the Butte-Silver Bow Sabey proposal. DCD reported Sabey was looking in Deer Lodge County and other southwest Montana locations after the Butte land deal collapsed, but no Deer Lodge County site, application, permit, or named project was found.

status_detail: No specific data center project found in Fallon County.

status_detail: No specific data center project found in Flathead County.

status_detail: Facility directories list Vision Net Bozeman at 112 North Black Avenue as an operational data center/colocation facility; US Data Center Map lists iConnect Bozeman as operational with 22.3 MW. Vision Net's own press material confirms it acquired iConnect Montana and added data center services.
notes: Capacity comes from US Data Center Map; the Inflect facility page supports location/operator/services. Vision Net's official press page supports iConnect acquisition and data center services, though it does not list the Bozeman address in the cited excerpt.

status_detail: DataCenterMap and Inflect list Montana Opticom Bozeman at 144 Quail Run Road/Four Corners as an operational data center/colocation facility with cabinets, cages, remote hands, cloud/connectivity services, N+1 reliability language, and Montana Opticom as operator.
notes: Inflect states 300 kVA power capacity while DC Hub search results report 3.0 MW; left capacity_mw null due to conflicting third-party capacity values.

status_detail: No specific data center project found in Golden Valley County.
notes: Golden Valley/Lavina residents are concerned about groundwater impacts from Quantica's proposed Broadview project, but Broadview is in Yellowstone County. A resident petition asks Golden Valley commissioners for transparency/protection regarding proposed or existing data center development, but no Golden Valley County project, permit, named site, or developer was found.

status_detail: US Data Center Map lists one operational Granite County facility named Data Center (MT) in Philipsburg with 16.5 MW capacity. No county official project/permit page or operator identity was found during quick search.
notes: Tracker-only evidence. WaterByCounty also reports one mapped data center facility in Granite County from EPA/OpenStreetMap layers, but with about 0 MW estimated load, so capacity_mw uses US Data Center Map and developer remains null.
